gold.head: Gold Battles Strong Dollar Below $4,000
gold.plain: Gold is fighting to hold breakout support around 3878.220 after dropping below the key $4,000 level. Strong US Dollar momentum and ongoing Fed tightening fears continue to limit rebound attempts despite seasonal tailwinds.
pts: Support Tested
Prices traded down to 3878.220 as a break below $4,000 has prompted more analysts to turn bearish.
Dollar Pressure
Persistent US Dollar strength and mixed US PPI figures offer little relief from Federal Reserve tightening worries.
Bulls Fight Back
Buyers are attempting to mount a rebound and defend support following a prior 7% rally, helped by seasonal factors.
gold.watch: USD Fed Chairman Warsh Speaks on 2026-11-16 12:00
gold.plan: Wait for clear defense of support against the strong dollar before taking fresh positions.
gold.name: XAUUSD

eur.head: Hawkish Fed Expectations Keep Euro Under Pressure
eur.plain: Growing expectations for a hawkish Federal Reserve and French debt risks are pushing the euro toward yearly lows. This environment favors the US dollar as traders monitor high-impact central bank speeches and retail sales data this week.
pts: Fed Rate Bets
Hawkish Federal Reserve bets are boosting the dollar and threatening a push below 1.1000.
Euro Area Headwinds
Concerns surrounding French debt risks and the ECB rate outlook are dampening demand for the euro.
Range at Risk
A five-week trading range is now placing yearly lows on the line for the pair.
eur.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh Speaks on November 16 at 12:00
eur.plan: Exercise caution around key central bank speeches and monitor price action closely near multi-week support levels.
eur.name: EURUSD

gbp.head: Dollar Strength Weighs on the British Pound
gbp.plain: The British Pound is facing weekly losses as firm US producer inflation keeps Federal Reserve hawks in control and pushes the US Dollar toward yearly highs. This sustained dollar rally keeps the pressure firmly on GBP/USD ahead of key central bank speeches and economic releases this week.
pts: Dollar Tests Highs
The US Dollar continues its broad rally toward yearly highs following hot US inflation data.
Sterling Struggles
The British Pound faces weekly losses as Fed policy expectations boost demand for the greenback.
Heavy Event Risk
Upcoming speeches from Fed Chairman Warsh and UK earnings data could inject fresh volatility into the pair.
gbp.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh speaking today, followed by UK Average Earnings Index data tomorrow.
gbp.plan: Approach GBP/USD with caution given the strong US Dollar trend, and manage risk carefully ahead of high-impact central bank events.
gbp.name: GBPUSD

jpy.head: USD/JPY Stalls Near 160 as Intervention Fears Rise
jpy.plain: USD/JPY hit 10-week highs near 160.00 following stronger-than-expected U.S. core PPI data, but the rally quickly stalled. This resistance matters because mounting fears of Japanese intervention have triggered sharp pullbacks and cautious trading at these levels.
pts: Intervention Risks at 160
The push toward 160.00 has stalled as technical warning signs elevate the risk of Japanese authorities stepping in.
Inflation Support
Hotter U.S. October core PPI figures kept the dollar supported around 159.86 despite overhead resistance.
Sharp Resistance Pullback
Reflecting trader nervousness near seven-week highs, price quickly slipped from 159.90 to 159.55.
jpy.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh speaks on November 16 at 12:00.
jpy.plan: Stay alert near the critical 160 level and manage risk tightly against potential intervention headlines.
jpy.name: USDJPY

oil.head: Oil Swings Between Surplus Fears and Middle East Tensions
oil.plain: Crude prices are caught between concerns over a growing supply surplus and headline risks from ongoing Middle East conflict. This dynamic creates volatile, mixed trading for USOIL as markets balance U.S. inventory builds against potential ceasefire developments.
pts: Surplus Pressures
Signs of an expanding supply surplus and U.S. inventory builds are keeping downward pressure on weekly price action.
Geopolitical Swings
Headlines regarding the Iran war and potential ceasefire talks continue to trigger sharp, reactive moves in crude markets.
Higher Long-Term Outlook
Goldman Sachs lifted its 2026 WTI average forecast to $79 a barrel, pointing to potential support further down the road.
oil.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh speech on November 16 at 12:00 USD
oil.plan: Trade defensively and prepare for sudden headline-driven volatility as ceasefire headlines and supply data clash.
oil.name: USOIL

nifty.head: NIFTY Faces Tug-of-War Between Weekly Gains and Global Tensions
nifty.plain: NIFTY is balancing solid multi-week gains and foreign investor buying against sharp selling pressure driven by geopolitical uncertainty. These mixed cues mean traders are seeing heightened volatility between broader weekly momentum and sudden headline-driven pullbacks.
pts: Geopolitical Pressure
The index experienced sharp drops as speeches offered no clear timeline for resolving international conflicts, keeping markets under pressure.
Underlying Weekly Strength
Despite sudden pullbacks, NIFTY managed to extend its weekly winning streak for a third week alongside continued FII buying.
Sector Rotation
PSU banks and smallcaps have led gains as an AI retreat helped fuel a rotational comeback into Indian equities.
nifty.watch: Geopolitical conflict developments and foreign institutional buying trends
nifty.plan: Stay flexible and manage risk carefully while the market navigates conflicting global headlines and domestic momentum.
nifty.name: NIFTY
